items.source: transaction - object returned by the getTransaction method
items.translation: transaction - 由 getTransaction 方法返回的对象

items.source: Note: In contrast to PlatformTransactionManager, exceptions are propagated through the reactive pipeline returned from this method. Also, depending on the transaction manager implementation, commit may propagate DataAccessException as well.
items.translation: 注意：与PlatformTransactionManager相反，此方法返回的反应式管道会传播异常。此外，根据事务管理器实现的不同，commit也可能传播DataAccessException。

items.source: Note: In contrast to PlatformTransactionManager, exceptions are propagated through the reactive pipeline returned from this method. Also, depending on the transaction manager implementation, rollback may propagate DataAccessException as well.
items.translation: 注意：与PlatformTransactionManager不同，此方法返回的反应式管道中会传播异常。此外，根据事务管理器实现的不同，rollback也可能传播DataAccessException。

items.source: Note: In contrast to PlatformTransactionManager, exceptions are propagated through the reactive pipeline returned from this method.
items.translation: 注意：与PlatformTransactionManager不同，此方法返回的反应式管道会传播异常。

items.source: Do not call rollback on a transaction if commit failed. The transaction will already have been completed and cleaned up when commit returns, even in case of a commit exception. Consequently, a rollback call after commit failure will lead to an IllegalTransactionStateException.
items.translation: 如果提交失败，请勿对事务调用 rollback。 即使发生提交异常，当 commit 返回时，事务也已完成并清理。因此，在提交失败后调用 rollback 将导致 IllegalTransactionStateException。

items.source:
Note that when the commit call completes, no matter if normally or
propagating an exception, the transaction must be fully completed and
cleaned up. No rollback call should be expected in such a case.
items.translation: 请注意，无论 `commit` 调用是正常完成还是传播了异常，事务都必须完全完成并清理。在这种情况下，不应期望有回滚调用。

items.source:
This is the central interface in Spring's reactive transaction infrastructure.
Applications can use this directly, but it is not primarily meant as an API:
Typically, applications will work with either transactional operators or
declarative transaction demarcation through AOP.
items.translation: 这是 Spring 响应式事务基础设施中的核心接口。应用程序可以直接使用它，但它主要不是作为 API 设计的：通常，应用程序将使用事务操作符或通过 AOP 进行声明式事务划分来工作。

items.source: IllegalTransactionStateException - if the given transaction is already completed (that is, committed or rolled back)
items.translation: IllegalTransactionStateException - 如果给定的事务已经完成（即已提交或回滚）

items.source: definition - the TransactionDefinition instance, describing propagation behavior, isolation level, timeout etc.
items.translation: definition - 描述传播行为、隔离级别、超时等的 TransactionDefinition 实例。

items.source:
Note that parameters like isolation level or timeout will only be applied
to new transactions, and thus be ignored when participating in active ones.
items.translation: 请注意，诸如隔离级别或超时之类的参数仅适用于新事务，因此在参与活跃事务时将被忽略。

items.source:
Furthermore, not all transaction definition settings will be supported
by every transaction manager: A proper transaction manager implementation
should throw an exception when unsupported settings are encountered.
items.translation: 此外，并非所有事务定义设置都能被每个事务管理器支持：适当的事务管理器实现应在遇到不支持的设置时抛出异常。

items.source:
An exception to the above rule is the read-only flag, which should be
ignored if no explicit read-only mode is supported. Essentially, the
read-only flag is just a hint for potential optimization.
items.translation: 上述规则的一个例外是只读标志，如果未支持显式的只读模式，则应忽略该标志。本质上，只读标志仅是对潜在优化的提示。

items.source:
If the transaction wasn't a new one, omit the commit for proper
participation in the surrounding transaction. If a previous transaction
has been suspended to be able to create a new one, resume the previous
transaction after committing the new one.
items.translation: 如果该事务不是新事务，则省略提交操作以正确参与周围的事务。如果之前已挂起一个事务以便创建新事务，则在提交新事务后恢复之前的事务。

items.source:
If the transaction wasn't a new one, just set it rollback-only for proper
participation in the surrounding transaction. If a previous transaction
has been suspended to be able to create a new one, resume the previous
transaction after rolling back the new one.
items.translation: 如果该事务不是新事务，则将其设置为仅回滚状态，以便正确参与周围的事务。如果之前已挂起一个事务以创建新事务，则在回滚新事务后恢复之前的事务。

items.source: Commit the given transaction, with regard to its status.
items.translation: 提交给定事务，根据其状态进行处理。

items.source:
Emit a currently active reactive transaction or create a new one, according to
the specified propagation behavior.
items.translation: 根据指定的传播行为，发出当前活动的响应式事务或创建一个新的事务。

items.source: Perform a rollback of the given transaction.
items.translation: 回滚给定的事务。

items.source: TransactionException - in case of lookup, creation, or system errors
items.translation: TransactionException - 在查找、创建或系统错误的情况下

items.source: IllegalTransactionStateException - if the given transaction definition cannot be executed (for example, if a currently active transaction is in conflict with the specified propagation behavior)
items.translation: IllegalTransactionStateException - 如果给定的事务定义无法执行（例如，当前活动的事务与指定的传播行为冲突）

items.source: UnexpectedRollbackException - in case of an unexpected rollback that the transaction coordinator initiated
items.translation: UnexpectedRollbackException - 在事务协调器发起的意外回滚的情况下

items.source: HeuristicCompletionException - in case of a transaction failure caused by a heuristic decision on the side of the transaction coordinator
items.translation: HeuristicCompletionException - 在由事务协调器侧的启发式决策导致的事务失败的情况下

items.source: TransactionSystemException - in case of commit or system errors (typically caused by fundamental resource failures)
items.translation: TransactionSystemException - 在提交或系统错误时（通常由基本资源故障引起）

items.source: TransactionSystemException - in case of rollback or system errors (typically caused by fundamental resource failures)
items.translation: TransactionSystemException - 在回滚或系统错误时（通常由基本资源故障引起）

items.source: Mark Paluch, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Mark Paluch，Juergen Hoeller

items.source: transaction status object representing the new or current transaction
items.translation: 代表新事务或当前事务的事务状态对象
